# StarsBio — The Definitive Celebrity Birthdays & Biographies Directory
> https://www.starsbio.co.uk

StarsBio is a high-authority digital biographical directory documenting 17,500+ verified public figures, actors, musicians, athletes, creators, and historical icons. Every profile is backed by verified birth dates, live chronological age calculations, zodiac profiles, family insights, and career achievements.

## Primary Canonical URL
- Canonical Site: https://www.starsbio.co.uk
- Sitemap Index: https://www.starsbio.co.uk/sitemap.xml
- Robots Policy: https://www.starsbio.co.uk/robots.txt

## Main Directories
- Celebrity Profiles: https://www.starsbio.co.uk/people/[slug]
- Head-to-Head Comparison Engine: https://www.starsbio.co.uk/compare
- 365-Day Birthday Calendar: https://www.starsbio.co.uk/birthdays/[month]/[day]
- Category & Profession Hubs: https://www.starsbio.co.uk/category
- Astrological Zodiac Hubs: https://www.starsbio.co.uk/zodiac
- In Memoriam Archive: https://www.starsbio.co.uk/in-memoriam
- Editorial & In-Depth Stories: https://www.starsbio.co.uk/blog

## Content Methodology & Standards
- Real-Time Ages: All ages and next birthday countdowns are computed dynamically to ensure 100% calendar accuracy.
- Fact Verification: Data cross-referenced with encyclopedic records and official documentation under UK GDPR and DPA 2018 guidelines.
- Contact & Editorial: editor.starsbio@gmail.com
